item.title: 库克确认国行 Apple 智能本月推出测试版
item.guid: 库克确认国行-Apple-智能本月推出测试版
item.description:
On October 15, during a visit to Blue Box in Shanghai and an interview, Tim Cook confirmed to iFanr that Apple has been approved to provide the first batch of Apple Intelligence core features to Chinese users, with plans to launch them in a beta version later this month. 10 月 15 日，库克在上海探访蓝盒子、接受采访时向爱范儿确认，苹果已获批向中国用户提供首批 Apple 智能核心功能，计划在本月晚些时候的测试版中推出。

The first batch of features includes real-time translation, the photo app's removal tool, and writing tools, but does not include the new Siri AI assistant. 首批功能包括实时翻译、照片 App 的消除工具及写作工具，但不包含全新的 Siri AI 助手。

According to sources, Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen will be integrated as an AI capability into Apple Intelligence, bringing a smart experience to Chinese users of iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS. Users will be able to directly experience Qianwen's text and image understanding, content generation, and other capabilities on Apple devices without switching between applications. 据消息人士透露，阿里千问将作为 AI 能力集成至 Apple智能，为 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 的中国用户带来智能体验。用户无需在应用间切换，即可在 Apple 设备上直接体验千问的文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力。

Apple's collaboration plan with Alibaba has also been gradually disclosed: iFanr exclusively learned that the cooperation includes at least two forms: integrating Qianwen's capabilities into Apple Intelligence, and jointly training exclusive models for the Chinese market. 苹果与阿里巴巴的合作方案此前也已逐步公开：爱范儿独家获悉，合作至少包括将千问能力集成进 Apple 智能，以及双方共同训练面向中国市场的专属模型两种形式。

Alibaba previously introduced to iFanr that Qianwen will provide text and image understanding, content generation, and other capabilities for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS Chinese users; both parties will also jointly optimize models around local needs and services. 阿里巴巴此前向爱范儿介绍，千问将为 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 中国用户提供文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力；双方也将围绕本地需求和服务共同优化模型。

🔗 Related reading: Exclusive | Cook confirms Apple's China-specific AI, beta version to launch by end of October! 🔗 相关阅读： 独家｜库克确认苹果国行 AI，10 月底上线测试版！

item.title: DeepSeek 崩了 5 小时后恢复
item.guid: DeepSeek-崩了-5-小时后恢复
item.description:
DeepSeek issued a service recovery and compensation notice on the afternoon of October 15, apologizing for the API service outage from 8:11 to 13:04 that day, and announced a full refund in the form of bonus credits based on the actual consumption amount of user accounts from October 8 to 14. DeepSeek 10 月 15 日下午发布服务恢复及补偿通知，就当天 8:11 至 13:04 的 API 服务故障致歉，并宣布按用户账号 10 月 8 日至 14 日的实际消耗金额，以赠金形式全额返还。

According to reports from Yicai and The Paper, the bonus credits will be automatically credited to accounts, and subsequent API billing will prioritize deduction from the bonus credit account. The refund amount depends on each account's actual call consumption over the past week. This compensation targets API consumption and is not a cash distribution to all app users. 据第一财经、澎湃新闻报道，赠金将自动到账，后续 API 计费优先从赠金账户扣除，返还额度取决于各账号过去一周的实际调用消费。这项补偿针对 API 消耗，并非面向所有 App 用户发放现金。

The official statement said that a comprehensive investigation and rectification of service stability has been launched, and single-point dependencies will be identified and removed. During the morning outage, dialogue and two API services were affected; at 9:06, the official stated that the cause had been identified, at 12:49, it was updated that a fix had been implemented and was being monitored, and at 13:04, recovery was confirmed. 官方称，已启动针对服务稳定性的全面排查和整改，将梳理并剥离单点依赖。上午故障期间，对话及两路 API 服务受到影响；9:06 官方表示已定位原因，12:49 更新为已实施修复、正在监控，13:04 确认恢复。

item.title: iPhone Duo 维修价格公布，内屏损坏预估 7998 元
item.guid: iPhone-Duo-维修价格公布，内屏损坏预估-7998-元
item.description:
The repair prices for Apple's first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, have been announced. According to a Jiemian News report on October 15 and the Apple official website's fee schedule it displayed, the estimated out-of-warranty service fee for internal screen damage is 7998 yuan, for external screen damage is 3198 yuan, and for battery service is 1898 yuan. 苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 的维修价格已公布。据界面新闻 10 月 15 日报道及其展示的苹果官网收费表，保外内屏损坏的预估服务费为 7998 元，外屏损坏为 3198 元，电池服务为 1898 元。

Under AppleCare+ coverage, the service fee for internal screen damage drops to 628 yuan, and for external screen damage to 188 yuan. The AppleCare+ plan for iPhone Duo is priced at 2599 yuan, with the plan fee and each repair service fee calculated separately. 在 AppleCare+ 保障下，内屏损坏服务费降至 628 元，外屏损坏为 188 元。iPhone Duo 的 AppleCare+ 计划价格为 2599 元，计划费用与每次维修的服务费分别计算。

Apple's support page states that devices need to be inspected to determine the final service fee; out-of-warranty estimated fees apply to repairs provided by Apple, while authorized service providers can set their own out-of-warranty charges. Jiemian News learned after inquiring with Apple customer service that "other damages" may involve more components such as cameras and motherboards, and the actual quote will still be assessed by store engineers. 苹果支持页说明，设备需要经过检查，才能确定最终服务费；保外预估费用适用于由苹果提供的维修，授权服务商可以自行设定保外收费。界面新闻询问苹果客服后获悉，「其他损坏」可能涉及摄像头、主板等更多部件，实际报价仍由门店工程师评估。

iPhone Duo will begin pre-orders on October 16 and officially go on sale on October 23, offering four storage capacities and two color options: Starlight White and Midnight Blue. iPhone Duo 将于 10 月 16 日开启预售，10 月 23 日正式发售，提供四种存储容量，以及星光白、夜空色两种配色。

item.title: 蚂蚁阿福与支付宝 AI 支付入选《时代》年度最佳发明
item.guid: 蚂蚁阿福与支付宝-AI-支付入选《时代》年度最佳发明
item.description:
TIME magazine announced its list of the best inventions of 2026 on October 15, with Ant Group's health AI application Ant AQ (Ant Afu) and Alipay AI Pay being selected in the "Health & Wellness" and "Finance & Digital Assets" categories, respectively. 《时代》周刊 10 月 15 日公布 2026 年度最佳发明榜单，蚂蚁集团旗下健康 AI 应用蚂蚁阿福（AQ）和支付宝 AI 支付分别入选「健康与福祉」及「金融与数字资产」类别。

TIME's introduction to Ant AQ focuses on the accessibility of medical services: users can upload photos of skin problems, first receiving a preliminary diagnosis from AI, then connecting with a doctor for confirmation or correction. The application was launched in 2025, and its user base exceeded 150 million in September this year. The preliminary AI diagnosis and subsequent doctor confirmation are two distinct stages clearly differentiated in the introduction. 《时代》对蚂蚁阿福的介绍聚焦医疗服务可及性：用户可上传皮肤问题照片，先由 AI 提供初步判断，再连接医生进行确认或纠正。该应用于 2025 年推出，今年 9 月用户规模超过 1.5 亿。AI 初步判断与后续医生确认，是介绍中明确区分的两个环节。

Alipay AI Pay allows compatible intelligent agents, applications, and devices to complete transactions after user authorization. Users first state their needs in natural language, the intelligent agent retrieves options, asks for user confirmation, and then executes payment; TIME states that over 100 million people have used this service, and more than 120 million transactions were processed in one week in February this year. 支付宝 AI 支付则让兼容的智能体、应用和设备在用户授权后完成交易。用户先用自然语言提出需求，智能体检索选项、请用户确认，再执行支付；《时代》称，已有超过 1 亿人使用这项服务，今年 2 月一周内处理的交易超过 1.2 亿笔。

This year's list includes 300 best inventions, with an additional 100 special mentions. Evaluation criteria include originality, effectiveness, innovative ambition, and impact. 本年度榜单共收录 300 项最佳发明，另设 100 项特别提名，评选考量包括原创性、效能、创新雄心与影响力。

item.title: 《GTA VI》发布发售宣传片，全片由 PS5 录制
item.guid: 《GTA-VI》发布发售宣传片，全片由-PS5-录制
item.description:
Rockstar Games released the launch trailer for "GTA VI" on October 15. The approximately 90-second video once again showcased scenes from Vice City and the state of Leonida. The game is scheduled to launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, five weeks away from release. Rockstar Games 于 10 月 15 日发布《GTA VI》发售宣传片，约 90 秒的影像再次展示了罪恶都市及 Leonida 州的场景。游戏计划于 11 月 19 日登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S，距离发售还有五周。

According to The Verge, Rockstar stated that the new trailer was entirely recorded on PS5; the trailer's soundtrack features a new track by the electronic music duo Justice, who also contributed to the game's original score. 据 The Verge 报道，Rockstar 表示新片全部由 PS5 录制；宣传片配乐采用电子音乐组合 Justice 的新曲，该组合也参与游戏原声创作。

The story revolves around Jason and Lucia: after a seemingly easy operation goes wrong, the two become entangled in a criminal conspiracy spanning the state of Leonida, needing to rely on each other to escape. The new trailer primarily showcases characters and atmosphere, with a longer gameplay demonstration having been released in August. Thirteen years have passed since the launch of the previous main "GTA" title. 故事围绕 Jason 和 Lucia 展开：一次看似轻松的行动失手后，两人卷入遍及 Leonida 州的犯罪阴谋，需要依靠彼此脱身。新片主要呈现角色和氛围，更长的玩法展示已于 8 月公布。距离上一部《GTA》正作推出，已过去 13 年。

item.title: Rivian 计划接入第三方 AI 智能体，刹车与转向不交给 Agent
item.guid: Rivian-计划接入第三方-AI-智能体，刹车与转向不交给-Agent
item.description:
Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe stated at this week's TechCrunch Disrupt event that the company plans to allow its vehicles to run AI agents from external companies like Anthropic. Rivian has already launched its self-developed in-car AI assistant, with third-party integration still part of its next phase of planning. Rivian 创始人兼 CEO RJ Scaringe 在本周 TechCrunch Disrupt 现场表示，公司计划让汽车运行 Anthropic 等外部公司的 AI 智能体。Rivian 已推出自研车载 AI 助手，第三方接入仍属于下一步规划。

According to a TechCrunch on-site interview on October 15, Rivian's self-developed agent framework first determines user intent, then assigns tasks to either local in-car models or cloud-based models. Current uses include adjusting temperature, turning on seat heating, and summarizing news. As of May this year, it can already access external applications like Google Calendar. 据 TechCrunch 10 月 15 日的现场采访，Rivian 的自研智能体框架会先判断用户意图，再把任务交给车内本地模型或云端模型。现有用途包括调节温度、打开座椅加热和摘要新闻，今年 5 月已能访问 Google Calendar 等外部应用。

Scaringe gave an example, saying that in the future, car owners could first request to turn on seat ventilation, and then continue discussing dinner plans that were talked about on other devices the previous day, allowing the in-car assistant to continue the existing conversation. This requires collaboration with model companies to integrate user context. Scaringe 举例说，车主今后可以先要求打开座椅通风，再接着聊起前一天在其他设备上讨论过的聚餐计划，让车载助手延续既有对话。这需要与模型公司协作，打通用户上下文。

He also clearly drew safety boundaries: agents cannot independently decide to brake or steer, and vehicle-level control will not be handed over to agents. Rivian has not provided a launch date for third-party integration, and will hold an AI and autonomous driving event in December. 他同时明确划出安全边界：智能体不能自行决定刹车或转向，车辆级控制不会交给 Agent。Rivian 未给出第三方接入的上线日期，后续将于 12 月举办 AI 与自动驾驶活动。

item.title: 字节跳动洽谈采购联发科数据中心定制芯片
item.guid: 字节跳动洽谈采购联发科数据中心定制芯片
item.description:
According to a Bloomberg report on October 15, ByteDance is in advanced talks with MediaTek for a data center chip supply agreement, with both parties close to reaching a deal. 据彭博社 10 月 15 日报道，字节跳动正与联发科深入洽谈数据中心芯片供货协议，双方接近达成交易。

Sources familiar with the matter stated that MediaTek plans to provide custom application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) tailored for ByteDance's platform to support its data center operations, with the procurement quantity yet to be determined. ASICs are chips designed around specific tasks or platforms, adopting a different design approach from general-purpose processors. 知情人士称，联发科拟提供为字节跳动平台定制的专用集成电路（ASIC），用于支撑其数据中心运行，采购数量尚未确定。ASIC 是围绕特定任务或平台设计的芯片，与通用处理器采用不同的设计路线。

Reuters subsequently relayed this negotiation news. Both parties are currently still in the agreement negotiation phase. 路透社随后转述了这项洽谈消息。双方目前仍处于协议磋商阶段。

item.title: 沃尔沃扩大与英伟达合作，未来车型将采用新自动驾驶技术栈
item.guid: 沃尔沃扩大与英伟达合作，未来车型将采用新自动驾驶技术栈
item.description:
Volvo Cars announced on October 15 that it is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA, integrating its vehicle safety systems with NVIDIA AI and accelerated computing technology for assisted and autonomous driving capabilities in next-generation models. 沃尔沃汽车 10 月 15 日宣布扩大与英伟达的合作，将自家的车辆安全系统与英伟达 AI、加速计算技术结合，用于下一代车型的辅助与自动驾驶能力。

The new collaboration covers the Hyperion sensor and computing architecture, Halos OS, and Alpamayo Stack driving software. Both parties hope that vehicles will be able to handle complete journeys from highways and busy city streets to parking scenarios, and gradually introduce the ability for drivers to take their eyes off the road and further disengage from driving tasks. 新的合作覆盖 Hyperion 传感器与计算架构、Halos OS，以及 Alpamayo Stack 驾驶软件。双方希望车辆能处理从高速公路、繁忙城市街道到停车场景的完整行程，并逐步引入驾驶者可移开视线、进一步脱离驾驶任务的能力。

Volvo stated that this technology will first be used in a next-generation model, as part of the company's new product plan. The collaboration between the two parties began in 2017; this announcement describes future technology integration, and currently sold vehicles will not immediately gain the aforementioned autonomous driving capabilities as a result. 沃尔沃表示，这套技术将首先用于一款下一代车型，属于公司新一轮产品计划。双方合作始于 2017 年；本次公告描述的是未来技术导入，现售车辆并未因此立即获得上述自动驾驶能力。

item.title: 台积电第三季度净利润增近七成，2nm 贡献 8% 晶圆收入
item.guid: 台积电第三季度净利润增近七成，2nm-贡献-8%-晶圆收入
item.description:
On October 15, TSMC announced its third-quarter results as of September 30: under TIFRS consolidated standards, revenue was NT$1,494.24 billion, a year-on-year increase of 50.9%; net profit was NT$763.06 billion, a year-on-year increase of 68.7% and a quarter-on-quarter increase of 8.0%. Diluted earnings per share were NT$29.43. 10 月 15 日，台积电公布截至 9 月 30 日的第三季度业绩：按 TIFRS 合并口径，营收为 14942.4 亿新台币，同比增长 50.9%；净利润为 7630.6 亿新台币，同比增长 68.7%，环比增长 8.0%。稀释后每股收益为 29.43 新台币。

In USD, quarterly revenue was $46.72 billion, a year-on-year increase of 41.2%. TSMC's gross margin for the quarter was 66.4%, operating margin was 58.7%, and net profit margin was 51.1%. 以美元计，季度营收为 467.2 亿美元，同比增长 41.2%。台积电本季毛利率为 66.4%，营业利润率为 58.7%，净利润率为 51.1%。

Regarding process technology structure, 2nm already accounts for 8% of wafer revenue, while 3nm, 5nm, and 7nm account for 33%, 28%, and 10% respectively; 7nm and more advanced processes collectively account for 79%. CFO Wendell Huang stated that this quarter's business was supported by strong demand for advanced processes, and the fourth quarter will continue to benefit from this demand, including the rapid ramp-up of 2nm. 制程结构方面，2nm 已占晶圆收入的 8%，3nm、5nm 和 7nm 分别占 33%、28% 和 10%；7nm 及更先进制程合计占 79%。CFO 黄仁昭表示，本季业务受到先进制程强劲需求支撑，第四季度仍将受惠于这股需求，包括 2nm 的快速爬坡。

The company expects fourth-quarter revenue to be between $52.3 billion and $54.3 billion; gross margin to be between 65% and 67%, and operating margin to be between 56.5% and 58.5%. 公司预计第四季度营收为 523 亿美元至 543 亿美元；毛利率为 65% 至 67%，营业利润率为 56.5% 至 58.5%。

item.title: Anthropic IPO 估值预期降温，部分投资者讨论 1.5 万亿美元
item.guid: Anthropic-IPO-估值预期降温，部分投资者讨论-1.5-万亿美元
item.description:
According to Reuters on October 15, some existing and potential IPO investors of Anthropic have begun discussing a valuation of approximately $1.5 trillion, lower than the previous expectation of about $2 trillion for a November offering. The information comes from four informed sources and represents investor discussions, not final offering pricing. 据路透社 10 月 15 日报道，部分 Anthropic 现有及潜在 IPO 投资者开始讨论约 1.5 万亿美元的估值，低于此前对 11 月发行约 2 万亿美元的预期。消息来自四名知情人士，属于投资者讨论，尚非最终发行定价。

Anthropic stated at Wednesday's investor meeting that third-quarter revenue was $16.8 billion, a 45% quarter-over-quarter increase, achieving profitability on an adjusted basis for the quarter. Second-quarter revenue was $11.6 billion, more than double that of the first quarter; some investors were disappointed by the slowdown in quarter-over-quarter growth in the latest quarter. Anthropic 在周三的投资者会议上表示，第三季度营收为 168 亿美元，环比增长 45%，当季按经调整口径实现盈利。第二季度营收为 116 亿美元，较第一季度翻倍以上；部分投资者对最新一季环比增速放缓感到失望。

CEO Dario Amodei and CFO Krishna Rao attended the meeting held at the San Francisco headquarters. Reuters stated that the company did not immediately respond to requests for comment. CEO Dario Amodei 与 CFO Krishna Rao 出席了在旧金山总部举行的会议。路透社称，公司未立即回应置评请求。

item.title: Ramp 获 18.5 亿美元融资，估值升至 600 亿美元
item.guid: Ramp-获-18.5-亿美元融资，估值升至-600-亿美元
item.description:
Enterprise expense management company Ramp announced on October 15 the completion of a new round of financing. According to TechCrunch, this round raised $1.85 billion, valuing the company at $60 billion; this comes just four months after its $750 million financing in June at a $44 billion valuation. 企业费用管理公司 Ramp 于 10 月 15 日宣布完成新一轮融资。据 TechCrunch 报道，本轮规模为 18.5 亿美元，公司估值达到 600 亿美元；距离其 6 月以 440 亿美元估值融资 7.5 亿美元仅过去四个月。

This round was co-led by Dragoneer, Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Sands Capital, and Avenir Growth. Ramp's two co-CEOs disclosed in an open letter that day that the company has reached 85,000 customers, with annualized revenue exceeding $2 billion, and has achieved positive cash flow. The annualized revenue here is an estimated annual level based on the current business scale, not disclosed full-year revenue. 本轮由 Dragoneer、Thrive Capital、Founders Fund、Sands Capital 和 Avenir Growth 共同领投。Ramp 两位联合 CEO 在当天的公开信中披露，公司客户已达 8.5 万家，年化营收超过 20 亿美元，并实现正向现金流。这里的年化营收是按当前业务规模推算的年度水平，并非已披露的全年营收。

Ramp is expanding from corporate card and expense management to procurement, payments, accounts receivable, and accounting automation. AI expense management tools launched this year can track enterprise model spending, Router selects models for applications, and Glass saves automations, prompts, and skills created by the team for colleagues to reuse. The company is integrating new funding and business expansion into the growth path of a unified financial operations platform. Ramp 正从企业卡和报销管理扩展到采购、付款、应收账款与会计自动化。今年推出的 AI 费用管理工具可追踪企业的模型支出，Router 为应用选择模型，Glass 则保存团队做过的自动化、提示词与技能，供同事复用。公司将新资金与业务扩展，放在同一套财务运营平台的增长路径中。

item.title: 💡 特努斯：AI 不会让 iPhone 消失，苹果要做能带来差异的部分
item.guid: 💡-特努斯：AI-不会让-iPhone-消失，苹果要做能带来差异的部分
item.description:
In an interview published in Time magazine on October 15, Apple CEO John Ternus discussed that the emergence of super intelligence would not suddenly render phones useless. People still want to talk to others, look at photos of loved ones, and capture images, so he doesn't foresee a scenario where iPhones are no longer needed. 在《时代》周刊 10 月 15 日刊出的专访中，苹果 CEO 约翰·特努斯谈到，超级智能的出现不会令手机突然失去用途。人们仍想与他人交谈、看亲人的照片、拍摄影像，因此他看不到一个不再需要 iPhone 的情景。

Regarding Apple's choice to leverage Google Gemini technology to build its next-generation AI models, he believes that the company doesn't need to manufacture every part of its products itself, but should instead focus resources on areas that bring differentiation. He cited Siri AI as an example: with user permission, information accumulated on the phone can be used for tasks, learning, and content discovery; Apple hopes to make AI more practical through devices, systems, and personal context. 对于苹果借助 Google Gemini 技术构建新一代 AI 模型的选择，他认为，公司没有必要自行制造产品里的每一个部分，而应把资源放在能带来差异的环节。他以 Siri AI 为例：在用户许可下，手机中积累的信息可用于办事、学习与查找内容；苹果希望通过设备、系统和个人上下文，让 AI 更实用。

Regarding product trade-offs, Ternus also spoke about foldable screen development. He and his colleagues applied for relevant patents as early as 2011 but were unwilling to use surface materials they were not satisfied with. Richard Dinh, VP of Product Design, recalled that the team had asked if they should accept a solution similar to competitors' but still flawed, and Ternus encouraged them to continue searching for more suitable materials and manufacturing methods. 对产品取舍，特努斯还讲到了折叠屏研发。他与同事早在 2011 年便申请相关专利，但不愿采用自己不满意的表面材料。产品设计副总裁 Richard Dinh 回忆，团队曾询问是否接受与竞品相似、尚有缺陷的方案，特努斯鼓励他们继续寻找更合适的材料和制造方式。

Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing, Greg Joswiak, added in the same interview that the company's main goal is not to pursue super intelligence for hardcore believers, but to improve the experience for ordinary people. Ternus summarized his approach as: constrain the scope and dedicate energy to the most important things. 苹果全球营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 在同篇采访中补充，公司并非以追逐超级智能的铁杆信徒为主要目标，而是想改善普通人的体验。特努斯则将自己的方法概括为：约束范围，把精力投入最重要的事情。

item.title: 6999 元起，红魔 12 Pro+ 发布：185Hz 屏下全面屏、RGB 水冷
item.guid: 6999-元起，红魔-12-Pro+-发布：185Hz-屏下全面屏、RGB-水冷
item.description:
Red Magic released the Red Magic 12 Pro+ on October 15, featuring the 6th generation Snapdragon 8 Super Extreme Edition and its self-developed Red Core R5 gaming chip, along with updated screen, active cooling, and gaming system. The new phone will go on sale at 18:00 on the same day in official stores and authorized channels. 红魔于 10 月 15 日发布红魔 12 Pro+，搭载第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版与自研红芯 R5 电竞芯片，并更新屏幕、主动散热和游戏系统。新机将于当日 18:00 在官方店铺及授权渠道开售。

    Performance and Cooling: Equipped with LPDDR5T memory, UFS 4.1 Pro flash storage, supporting game upscaling, super frame, and ray tracing. The liquid cooling module includes RGB lighting effects, paired with an upgraded micro-pump and a 25500r/min active fan.

    Screen and Feel: Features 9th-generation under-display technology and BOE X11 luminous material, supporting a 185Hz refresh rate; the body is 8.5mm thick, weighs 223g, and comes in three colors: Transparent Dark Night, Transparent Silver Wing, and Transparent Ice Blue.

    Battery Life and System: Built-in 8400mAh battery, supporting 120W wired and 80W wireless fast charging, and bypass charging. REDMAGICOS 12 adds features such as cross-app memory, message reminders, and file transfer with iOS devices, while the PC emulator now includes Steam Workshop and achievement display.

The 12GB + 256GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB versions are priced at 6999 yuan, 7999 yuan, and 8999 yuan respectively. The 24GB + 1TB Ultimate Gold Legend Collector's Edition will also feature forged carbon cooling material, with launch details to be announced later. 12GB + 256GB、16GB + 512GB 和 16GB + 1TB 版本售价分别为 6999 元、7999 元和 8999 元。24GB + 1TB 臻金传奇典藏版还将采用锻造碳散热材料，上市安排后续公布。

Also unveiled was a Mini LED monitor priced at 6499 yuan, featuring 5184 independent dimming zones, supporting dual modes of 5K 180Hz and 2K 330Hz, with an all-aluminum body and transparent window design. 同场亮相、售价 6499 元的 Mini LED 显示器具有 5184 个独立分区，支持 5K 180Hz 与 2K 330Hz 双模式，采用全铝机身及透明视窗设计。

item.title: 小鹏 MONA L05 开启预售，16.98 万元起
item.guid: 小鹏-MONA-L05-开启预售，16.98-万元起
item.description:
Xpeng MONA L05 began pre-sales on October 15, positioned as a large five-seater SUV, offering both pure electric and super range-extended power options, with an official launch planned for October 29. 小鹏 MONA L05 于 10 月 15 日开启预售，定位大五座 SUV，提供纯电与超级增程两种动力，计划 10 月 29 日正式上市。

    Pure Electric Version: The 535 Max, 635 Max, and 635 Ultra SE pre-sale prices are 169,800 yuan, 179,800 yuan, and 191,800 yuan respectively; corresponding CLTC range is 535km, 635km, and 635km, equipped with a 183kW rear-wheel drive motor.

    Super Range-Extended Version: The 1310 Max and 1310 Ultra SE pre-sale prices are 169,800 yuan and 181,800 yuan respectively, equipped with a 37.2kWh battery; the official configuration table lists a CLTC pure electric range of 310km and a comprehensive range of 1310km.

    Space and Chassis: Length 4870mm, wheelbase 2940mm, trunk volume 702L, expandable to 1913L with rear seats folded down; features front MacPherson, rear five-link independent suspension, and DCC variable damping shock absorbers.

    Assisted Driving: The Max version is equipped with 1 Turing AI chip, with an effective computing power of 750TOPS, using the second-generation VLA Lite; the Ultra SE version has 2 chips, 1500TOPS, using the second-generation VLA. The cockpit is equipped with a 17.3-inch central control screen and W-HUD, with a rear cabin entertainment screen, upgraded seats, and a 20-speaker audio system listed as an upgrade package.

item.title: 亚马逊发布两款 Bee AI 设备，手环 74.99 美元起
item.guid: 亚马逊发布两款-Bee-AI-设备，手环-74.99-美元起
item.description:
Amazon released Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse on October 15, designed to organize daily conversations into summaries, to-dos, and reminders. Frontier is now on sale for $74.99; Eclipse will be available later, starting at $99.99. 亚马逊于 10 月 15 日发布 Bee Frontier 与 Bee Eclipse，用于把日常对话整理成摘要、待办和提醒。Frontier 已开售，售价 74.99 美元；Eclipse 将于稍后上市，起售价 99.99 美元。

Frontier can be worn on the wrist or clipped to clothing, featuring dual microphones, IP67 water resistance, and a USB-C port, with a battery life of up to 7 days. Eclipse is a card-style device that magnetically attaches to the back of a phone, offering over 21 days of battery life on a single charge. Frontier 可戴在手腕或夹在衣物上，配有双麦克风、IP67 防水和 USB-C 接口，续航最长 7 天。Eclipse 则是磁吸在手机背面的卡片式设备，单次充电续航超过 21 天。

Basic services include conversation summaries and 14 days of memory. Accessing features like Alexa+, Amazon.com and third-party apps, and automatic to-do suggestions requires a monthly Bee Pro subscription of $11.99, with a 30-day free trial for new users. 基础服务包含对话摘要和 14 天记忆。接入 Alexa+、Amazon.com 及第三方应用、自动建议待办等功能，需要每月 11.99 美元的 Bee Pro 订阅，新用户可试用 30 天。

Amazon states that audio is deleted after real-time processing and recordings are not saved; transcribed text is encrypted, and users can delete text and summaries. Both devices have a microphone switch and an indicator light, and will prompt users to obtain participant consent before initiating call recording. 亚马逊称，音频经实时处理后删除，不保存录音；转写文本加密，用户可删除文本与摘要。两款设备均有麦克风开关和工作指示灯，发起通话录制时会提示先取得参与者同意。

item.title: 小米开源 MiDashengLM-Spatial，让模型判断声音方向与运动
item.guid: 小米开源-MiDashengLM-Spatial，让模型判断声音方向与运动
item.description:
Xiaomi's technical team announced on October 15 the open-sourcing of the spatial audio understanding large model MiDashengLM-Spatial. Based on MiDashengLM-7B, the model can understand speech, environmental sounds, and music content while also determining sound source direction, relative position, and movement trajectory. 小米技术团队 10 月 15 日宣布开源空间音频理解大模型 MiDashengLM-Spatial。模型以 MiDashengLM-7B 为基础，可在理解语音、环境声和音乐内容的同时，判断声源方向、相对位置及运动轨迹。

It uses a dual-branch audio encoder: the original semantic branch is responsible for sound content, while the new lightweight spatial branch processes binaural signals and receives semantic features for assisted localization. The binaural audio used for training spatial capabilities is approximately 10,000 hours, which is less than the original audio base's data scale of over 1 million hours. 它采用双分支音频编码器：原有语义分支负责声音内容，新增的轻量空间分支处理双耳信号，并接收语义特征辅助定位。训练空间能力所用的双耳音频约为 1 万小时，小于原有音频基座超过 100 万小时的数据规模。

The team also used "swapping left and right channels" to check if the model truly utilized binaural signals: if a sound originally from the left side was moved to the right, the answer should change accordingly. Xiaomi states that while the new model expands spatial capabilities, its general audio understanding ability remains largely on par with the base model. 团队还用「交换左右声道」检查模型是否真正利用了双耳信号：原本来自左侧的声音换到右侧后，答案也应相应改变。小米称，新模型在扩展空间能力的同时，通用音频理解能力与基座基本持平。

Model weights and inference code are released under the Apache 2.0 license, available for commercial integration or academic research. Xiaomi plans to gradually apply these capabilities to scenarios such as smart homes and automotive cockpits. 模型权重与推理代码以 Apache 2.0 许可证公开，可用于商业集成或学术研究。小米计划将相关能力陆续应用于智能家居、汽车座舱等场景。

item.title: Meta 开放 Muse Spark Open 权重，两台 Mac Studio 可本地运行
item.guid: Meta-开放-Muse-Spark-Open-权重，两台-Mac-Studio-可本地运行
item.description:
Meta released Muse Spark Open on October 15 and made its model weights available. It features a native multimodal design with a total of 816 billion parameters, 42 billion active parameters, and supports 1 million token context, primarily aimed at programming, long-range agent tasks, and multi-step reasoning. Meta 于 10 月 15 日发布 Muse Spark Open，并开放模型权重。它采用原生多模态设计，总参数为 8160 亿、激活参数为 420 亿，支持 100 万 token 上下文，主要面向编程、长程智能体任务与多步骤推理。

Meta collaborated with Apple to optimize its operation on Apple Silicon. With the new version of MLX, two M5 Ultra Mac Studios, each equipped with 512GB of unified memory, can accommodate the complete model. Meta demonstrated local workflows including modifying code for the open-source Mastodon client Ice Cubes, building applications, and having the model check footage frame by frame and operate DaVinci Resolve to complete editing. Meta 与苹果合作优化了 Apple Silicon 上的运行方式。借助新版 MLX，两台各配备 512GB 统一内存的 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 可以容纳完整模型。Meta 展示的本地工作流包括为开源 Mastodon 客户端 Ice Cubes 修改代码、构建应用，以及让模型逐帧检查素材、操作 DaVinci Resolve 完成剪辑。

Weights are available through platforms like Hugging Face, and the model is compatible with inference tools such as vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp. It uses the Muse Model License, and commercial use must comply with its restrictions. 权重已通过 Hugging Face 等平台提供，模型同时适配 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp 等推理工具。它采用 Muse Model License，商用需遵守该许可的限制。

item.title: Bluesky 扩展 Attie，用文字生成可分享的小游戏和投票
item.guid: Bluesky-扩展-Attie，用文字生成可分享的小游戏和投票
item.description:
Bluesky's AI tool Attie has added the ability to create small social applications. Users can input prompts to generate games, polls, or dashboards, and share the results as independent websites. Bluesky 的 AI 工具 Attie 新增了制作小型社交应用的能力。用户输入提示词后，可生成游戏、投票或仪表盘，并把成果作为独立网站分享。

According to a report by The Verge journalist Jay Peters on October 15, he generated a poll about "Pokémon Red/Blue" in a few minutes. The Attie website also showcases examples such as the "Flappy Butterfly" mini-game, a drum machine, quizzes, and idle clicker games, with each application having its own attie.site link and creator attribution at the bottom of the page. 据 The Verge 记者 Jay Peters 10 月 15 日的报道，他用几分钟生成了一项关于《宝可梦 红／蓝》的投票。Attie 网站还展示了「Flappy Butterfly」小游戏、鼓机、问答和放置点击游戏等示例，每个应用都有独立的 attie.site 链接，并在页面底部标注创作者。

Earlier this year, Attie was primarily used to create custom feeds via AI. Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider referred to this expansion as "social atmosphere programming" for communities in a TechCrunch Disrupt interview. The applications Peters experienced were mainly lightweight interactive ones. Attie 今年早些时候主要用于通过 AI 创建自定义信息流。Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 采访中把这次扩展称为面向社群的「社交氛围编程」。Peters 体验的应用以轻量互动为主。

item.title: 阶跃开放 Step 5 Preview 权重，同步公开长程 Agent 技术方案
item.guid: 阶跃开放-Step-5-Preview-权重，同步公开长程-Agent-技术方案
item.description:
On October 15, Jiyu Xingchen officially opened the BF16 and FP8 model weights for Step 5 Preview, simultaneously releasing a technical blog and accompanying development tools. The weights are now available on Hugging Face and ModelScope, allowing developers to deploy them independently and integrate data, tools, and business systems. 10 月 15 日，阶跃星辰正式开放 Step 5 Preview 的 BF16 和 FP8 模型权重，并同步发布技术博客与配套开发工具。权重已上线 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope，开发者可以自行部署并接入数据、工具与业务系统。

Step 5 Preview adopts a sparse MoE architecture, with a total of 600 billion parameters, activating 27 billion parameters per token, supporting 1 million token context, as well as text and visual input. The model is designed for long-range Agent tasks requiring multi-turn reasoning and tool invocation, and can deploy OpenAI-compatible services via vLLM, SGLang, and also supports Transformers offline inference. Step 5 Preview 采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量为 6000 亿，每个 token 激活 270 亿参数，支持 100 万 token 上下文，以及文本、视觉输入。模型面向需要多轮推理和工具调用的长程 Agent 任务，可通过 vLLM、SGLang 部署兼容 OpenAI 接口的服务，也支持 Transformers 离线推理。

The technical blog introduces that the model uses a 92-layer "narrow and deep" architecture, providing a deeper computational path for implicit multi-hop reasoning; Sparse GQA merges 8 adjacent tokens into an index block, reducing the overhead of indexing and top-k selection to one-eighth of the original. This optimization targets the attention indexing phase in long contexts. 技术博客介绍，模型采用 92 层「窄而深」架构，为隐式多跳推理提供更深的计算路径；Sparse GQA 将相邻的 8 个 token 合并为索引块，使索引与 top-k 选择开销降至原来的八分之一。这项优化针对长上下文中的注意力索引环节。

In terms of training, the team retained FP32 precision for key states and parameters, and used fine-grained gradient clipping to mitigate instability in deep training; long-range reinforcement learning incorporated context compression into policy training, allowing the model to learn to organize task states before continuing execution. 训练方面，团队在关键状态和参数上保留 FP32 精度，并采用细粒度梯度裁剪缓解深层训练不稳定；长程强化学习则将上下文压缩纳入策略训练，让模型学习整理任务状态后继续执行。

item.title: 蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1-flash，量化部署测试降至 4 卡
item.guid: 蚂蚁百灵开源-Ling-3.1-flash，量化部署测试降至-4-卡
item.description:
Ant Bailin open-sourced Ling-3.1-flash on October 15, with model weights available for download on Hugging Face and ModelScope. It is designed for complex tasks such as office work, software engineering, and tool invocation, and can be deployed in proprietary infrastructure. 蚂蚁百灵于 10 月 15 日开源 Ling-3.1-flash，模型权重已在 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 开放下载。它面向办公、软件工程和工具调用等复杂任务，可在自有基础设施中部署。

The model has a total of approximately 560 billion parameters, with about 25 billion parameters activated per token, supporting up to 1 million tokens of context. Bailin introduced that the model can organize reports based on scattered data, write functions around existing code, and continue to modify them based on test feedback; the team also provided the LingCode runtime framework, built on the open-source coding agent Pi, for long-term, multi-round tool invocation tasks, though the latter is not yet open-sourced. 模型总参数约 5600 亿，每个 token 激活约 250 亿参数，最高支持 100 万 token 上下文。百灵介绍，模型可根据分散资料整理报告，围绕既有代码编写功能，并根据测试反馈继续修改；团队还提供了基于开源编码智能体 Pi 构建的 LingCode 运行框架，用于长时间、多轮工具调用任务，后者尚未开源。

For deployment, Bailin uses MXFP4 quantization for routing experts and keeps dense layers at block-FP8, reducing weight occupancy from approximately 534GB to 292GB. In the Hopper GPU test configuration provided by the team, service deployment was reduced from 8 cards to 4 cards; the actual number of cards still varies with context length, concurrency, and service configuration. 部署方面，百灵对路由专家采用 MXFP4 量化，dense 层保持 block-FP8，将权重占用从约 534GB 降至 292GB。在团队给出的 Hopper GPU 测试配置中，服务部署由 8 卡降至 4 卡；实际卡数仍随上下文长度、并发量和服务配置变化。

The official release also provides a long-context parallel inference solution and strengthens JSON Schema tool invocation support. The public model repository lists deployment paths such as SGLang and vLLM, as well as different GPU configurations, for developers to verify according to actual tasks. 官方同时提供长上下文并行推理方案，并加强 JSON Schema 工具调用支持。公开模型仓库列出了 SGLang、vLLM 等部署路径及不同 GPU 配置，供开发者按实际任务验证。

item.title: Figma 推出 Specs，把 Markdown、设计稿和智能体放进同一画布
item.guid: Figma-推出-Specs，把-Markdown、设计稿和智能体放进同一画布
item.description:
Figma launched Specs on October 15, placing requirements specifications, design decisions, and technical solutions on a collaborative canvas. Teams can directly drag in existing Markdown files or have Figma agents assist in drafting; documents can also embed FigJam files, design frames, and canvas nodes, allowing text to update along with corresponding designs. Figma 于 10 月 15 日推出 Specs，将需求说明、设计决策和技术方案放到协作画布上。团队可以把现有 Markdown 文件直接拖入，或让 Figma 智能体协助起草；文档还能嵌入 FigJam 文件、设计画框和画布节点，让文字与对应设计一起更新。

Specs supports multi-person collaboration and comments. Figma agents can reply to comments and propose modifications within documents, and can also use connectors to bring in external context: for example, drafting technical solutions from GitHub code repositories, or calling Hex to analyze product data and leaving the results next to relevant issues. Specs 支持多人协作与评论。Figma 智能体可以在文档中回复评论、提出修改，也能借助连接器补入外部上下文：例如从 GitHub 代码库起草技术方案，或调用 Hex 分析产品数据，将结果留在相关问题旁边。

Once the team finalizes a solution, Specs can be handed over to programming agents via Figma's MCP service, along with Markdown, design references, diagrams, code layers, and Code Connect snippets. During implementation, new decisions and diagrams can also be written back to the original document. 团队确定方案后，可通过 Figma 的 MCP 服务把 Specs 交给编程智能体，连同 Markdown、设计引用、图表、代码层和 Code Connect 片段一起传递。实现过程中，也能把新决定与图表写回原来的文档。

Specs opened for public beta to paid plans starting that day, supporting web, desktop, and mobile. It can be created by pressing D in Figma or FigJam, or by clicking the Specs icon in the toolbar. Specs 从当日起向付费方案开放公测，支持网页、桌面和移动端。在 Figma 或 FigJam 中按 D，或点击工具栏的 Specs 图标即可创建。

item.title: 谷歌在 Willow 上验证「魔法态培育」，相关错误降至约四十分之一
item.guid: 谷歌在-Willow-上验证「魔法态培育」，相关错误降至约四十分之一
item.description:
Google's Quantum AI team announced on October 15 that they have validated the "magic state distillation" method on the Willow quantum processor. Compared to undistilled quantum states, related errors were reduced to about one-fortieth, and the logical fidelity of T states reached 99.99%. The research was published in Science on the same day. 谷歌 Quantum AI 团队 10 月 15 日宣布，在 Willow 量子处理器上验证了「魔法态培育」方法。与未经培育的量子态相比，相关错误降至约四十分之一，T 态的逻辑保真度达到 99.99%，研究同日发表于《Science》。

Magic states can be used to implement a class of operations required for universal quantum computing, but preparing high-quality magic states consumes significant resources and they cannot be reused after use. The new method is like a screening process: noisy quantum states are injected into small regions of the chip, errors are checked through a series of cooperative measurements, flawed attempts are discarded, and then low-error states are distilled. 魔法态可用于实现通用量子计算所需的一类操作，但制备高质量魔法态会消耗大量资源，使用后也无法重复利用。新方法像一道筛选工序：将含噪量子态注入芯片的小区域，通过一系列协同测量检查错误，剔除有缺陷的尝试，再培育出低错误状态。

The team also demonstrated transferring states from one error-correction encoding to another to connect subsequent computations. Google stated that further validation on a larger scale is still needed; these results are for the preparation and transfer of critical quantum states, and do not mean that the error rate for all tasks on the entire quantum computer has been reduced by 40 times. 团队还演示了将状态从一种纠错编码转移到另一种编码，以衔接后续计算。谷歌表示，仍需在更大规模上验证；这次结果针对关键量子态的制备与转移，并非整台量子计算机所有任务的错误率均降低 40 倍。

item.title: Ganni 与 lululemon 推出舞蹈联名系列，Jennifer Beals 出镜
item.guid: Ganni-与-lululemon-推出舞蹈联名系列，Jennifer-Beals-出镜
item.description:
Ganni and lululemon launched a collaborative collection of 22 items on October 15, inspired by 1980s dance films, combining athletic fabrics with Ganni's leopard print, ruffles, and other elements. Ganni 与 lululemon 于 10 月 15 日推出包含 22 件单品的联名系列，以 20 世纪 80 年代舞蹈电影为设计灵感，将运动面料与 Ganni 的豹纹、荷叶边等元素结合。

According to The Hollywood Reporter, the collection includes redesigned Define jackets, loose pullovers, barrel-leg pants, bodysuits, as well as accessories like leg warmers, shrugs, and headbands, using lululemon's Nulu and Softstreme fabrics. Some items adjust the silhouette between dance practice and daily wear through adjustable cuffs, wide necklines, and voluminous hems. 据 The Hollywood Reporter 介绍，系列包括重新设计的 Define 夹克、宽松套头衫、桶形长裤、连体衣，以及腿套、披肩式短上衣和发带等配件，使用 lululemon 的 Nulu 与 Softstreme 面料。部分单品通过可调裤脚、宽领口和蓬松下摆，调整练舞与日常穿着之间的轮廓。

The two brands invited Flashdance star Jennifer Beals and singer/dancer Mette to appear in the "Joy Is a Power Move" promotional short film, set in a dance studio. The collection is now available on both brands' official websites and in select international stores. 两品牌邀请《闪舞》主演 Jennifer Beals 与歌手、舞者 Mette 出演「Joy Is a Power Move」宣传短片，场景设在舞蹈工作室。系列已在双方官网及部分国际门店发售。

item.title: 特斯拉儿童平衡车开售，售价 1399 元
item.guid: 特斯拉儿童平衡车开售，售价-1399-元
item.description:
Tesla China's official online store began selling children's balance bikes at 10:00 AM on October 15, priced at 1399 yuan, targeting children aged 2 to 6. According to Jimu News' inquiry with customer service, the product is open for pre-order, and current orders are expected to be shipped before October 28. 特斯拉中国官网商店于 10 月 15 日上午 10:00 开售儿童平衡车，定价 1399 元，面向 2 至 6 岁儿童。据极目新闻向客服了解，产品已开放预订，当前订单预计在 10 月 28 日前发货。

This bike relies on children pushing off the ground with their feet to glide, without a motor or pedals. The frame is made of magnesium alloy, the product net weight is 5.6kg, the seat can be adjusted to 5 height levels, suitable for heights from 85 to 120cm, with a minimum leg length of 35cm, and a recommended maximum load capacity of 30kg. 这款车依靠儿童双脚蹬地滑行，没有电机和脚踏。车架采用镁合金，产品净重 5.6kg，座椅可进行 5 档高度调节，适用身高为 85 至 120cm、最低适配腿长为 35cm，建议承重上限为 30kg。

The handlebars have a built-in steering angle limiter to reduce the risk of tipping over due to excessive steering. The official website requires adult assembly and adjustment, and riding under adult supervision, wearing protective gear such as helmets, on flat, non-slip roads. 车把内置转向角度限位装置，以减少转向过大带来的翻倒风险。官网要求由成人组装和调整，并在成人监督下、佩戴头盔等防护装备，在平坦防滑的道路上骑行。

item.title: 抖音双 11 启动，主打现货并向豆包、红果等多端发券
item.guid: 抖音双-11-启动，主打现货并向豆包、红果等多端发券
item.description:
On October 15, the Douyin Mall Double 11 Shopping Festival kicked off, lasting until November 11. This year, the platform focuses on in-stock items, without pre-sales, and will distribute consumer vouchers in batches across multiple platforms including Douyin, Doubao, Hongguo Short Drama, and Toutiao. 10 月 15 日，抖音商城双 11 好物节启动，活动持续至 11 月 11 日。平台今年主打现货，不做预售，并在抖音、豆包、红果短剧、今日头条等多个端分批发放消费券。

Product discounts continue with two types of promotions: "instant discount" and "direct price drop," with merchants choosing one to participate in and bear the product discount; the platform will additionally invest in full-value consumer vouchers, allowing consumers to purchase single items without needing to bundle. The event is divided into the "Opening Red" phase from October 15 to 18, and the "Carnival" phase from November 7 to 11, with in-stock days and category days interspersed in between. 商品优惠延续「立减折扣」和「一件直降」两种玩法，由商家择一参与、承担商品折扣；平台另行投入全资消费券，消费者可单件购买、免凑单。活动分为 10 月 15 日至 18 日的开门红、11 月 7 日至 11 日的狂欢阶段，中间穿插现货日和品类日。

For merchants, the platform provides advertising subsidies, traffic incentives, and fulfillment support, and continues to expand AI tools: Compass AI Query supports conversational queries of operational indicators and analysis of abnormal signals, while Feige Smart Customer Service is temporarily free during the big promotion, supporting 24/7 reception. The official policy for small and medium-sized merchants applies to normally operating Douyin stores, excluding businesses such as instant retail, group buying delivery, and global shopping. 面向商家，平台提供投放补贴、流量激励及履约支持，并继续扩展 AI 工具：罗盘 AI 问数支持对话查询经营指标、分析异常信号，飞鸽智能客服在大促期间限时免费开放，支持全天接待。官方中小商家政策适用于正常经营的抖店，排除即时零售、团购配送和全球购等业务。

item.title: 《The Lowdown》第二季开播，Ethan Hawke 的记者迎来新案
item.guid: 《The-Lowdown》第二季开播，Ethan-Hawke-的记者迎来新案
item.description:
On October 14, US time, the second season of "The Lowdown" premiered on FX and Hulu with two episodes. Ethan Hawke continues to play Tulsa, Oklahoma reporter Lee Raybon, with Tommy Lee Jones and Betty Gilpin joining this season. 美国时间 10 月 14 日，《The Lowdown》第二季在 FX 和 Hulu 开播，首播两集。Ethan Hawke 继续饰演俄克拉何马州塔尔萨的记者 Lee Raybon，Tommy Lee Jones 和 Betty Gilpin 加入本季。

In the new season, Lee wins an award for his investigative reporting from the previous season, but delivers an out-of-control speech during the award ceremony. Public defender Ginger leads him to a new mystery: a former client who is still serving time has disappeared. Meanwhile, Lee's estranged father suddenly visits and begins to get close to a granddaughter he has never met, complicating family relationships beyond the investigation. 新一季中，Lee 因上一季的调查报道获奖，却在领奖时发表了一段失控的演说。公设辩护人 Ginger 将他带向一宗新谜案：一名仍在服刑的前客户失去了踪迹。与此同时，与 Lee 疏远的父亲突然到访，开始接近自己从未见过的孙女，让调查之外的家庭关系也变得复杂。

The series was created by Sterlin Harjo, who directed the first two episodes of this season and wrote the first episode. In an interview with "The Hollywood Reporter," Harjo stated that while the first season needed to establish characters and the world, the second season has more room to directly delve into Lee's life and further develop dark humor. The father-son dynamic between Hawke and Jones, and Gilpin's portrayal of the tense yet capable public defender, form the new relationships at the beginning of this season. 该剧由 Sterlin Harjo 创作，他执导了本季前两集，并编写首集。在《好莱坞报道者》的主创采访中，Harjo 表示，第一季需要建立人物和世界，第二季则有更多空间直接进入 Lee 的生活，也更能展开黑色幽默。Hawke 与 Jones 的父子对手戏，以及 Gilpin 饰演的紧张而能干的辩护人，构成了本季开篇的新关系。

item.title: 绿泡泡下架《好一个乖乖女》？抖音集团、出品方回应
item.guid: 绿泡泡下架《好一个乖乖女》？抖音集团、出品方回应
item.description:
According to a report by Beijing News Shell Finance on October 15, when a reporter searched for "What a Good Girl" on the WeChat mini-program "Green Bubble Short Drama," search results were still visible, but clicking on them displayed "This drama has been removed." 据新京报贝壳财经 10 月 15 日报道，记者在微信小程序「绿泡泡短剧」检索《好一个乖乖女》时，仍能看到搜索结果，但点击后页面显示「本剧已下架」。

A relevant person from the Douyin Group's short drama copyright center told reporters that the drama is their exclusive full-copyrighted work, currently still within its exclusive period, and has not yet been authorized to other independent short drama platforms. Li Juncheng, CEO of the production company Yu Jin Wuliang, also confirmed that the vertical screen version was initially launched exclusively on Hongguo and remains so to this day. 抖音集团短剧版权中心相关负责人向记者表示，该剧是其全版权独家剧，目前仍在独家期限内，尚未授权给其他独立短剧平台。出品方于今无量 CEO 李峻丞也确认，竖屏版最初在红果独家上线，至今仍是如此。

"What a Good Girl" premiered on Hongguo in early 2025, with a total of 88 episodes, starring Ke Chun and Yu Yin. Hongguo data shows that the drama's viewership exceeded 3 billion within one month of its launch, and reached 5 billion views on July 9 this year. 《好一个乖乖女》于 2025 年初上线红果，共 88 集，由柯淳、余茵主演。红果数据显示，该剧上线一个月播放量突破 30 亿，并于今年 7 月 9 日达到 50 亿播放量。

item.title: 出门带一堆充电头，包永远是鼓的？
item.guid: 出门带一堆充电头，包永远是鼓的？
item.description:
The Hard Candy Little Devil Max60 packs 60W into the size of a candy – approximately 33.8cm³ and 60g, easily slipped into your pocket on the go. 硬糖小魔头 Max60，把 60W 做进了一颗糖的体积里——约 33.8cm³、60g，口袋里随手一塞就走。

iPhone, tablet, thin and light laptop – one device handles it all. Even with a new iPhone, it can adapt through OTW cloud upgrades, so you don't need a new charger. iPhone、平板、轻薄本，一颗全搞定。换了新 iPhone 也能通过 OTW 云端升级适配，换机不换头。

During the Double Eleven period, WeChat mini-store offers 15% off with full discounts, and even more savings when stacked with other promotions. Get a lightweight 60W charger. 双十一期间微信小店满减 85 折，叠满减后更优惠，入手一颗轻巧的 60W。
